items.text: Add optional visual_triage field to haiku-output.schema.json (oneOf null | object with image_state enum, feature_identifiable bool, evidence_one_line <=160, screenshot_artifact_ref) — populated only when caller passes a screenshot ref
image_state closed enum semantics: blank | loading | error_overlay | partial_render | feature_visible | unreadable (partial_render stronger evidence than blank that app is alive)
feature_identifiable requires image_state==feature_visible AND content matches scenario feature label; wrong-feature => false (routing failure, tier-1 stop)
evidence_one_line discipline: strict observational only, <=160 chars single-clause, no judgment/UX/inference language
ci-observer.md visual-triage mode section after Validate mode: dispatch contract, image_state enum, discipline rules; add feature_identifiable + evidence_one_line to What-you-DO-report
feedback_haiku_observe_only_no_specifics.md memory footnote noting the visual-triage exception (closed-taxonomy + bounded one-liner = same discipline shape)
Orchestrator dispatch decision tree: tier-1 blank/error/partial -> infra action; feature_visible+identifiable -> tier-2; tier-2 complete -> optional tier-3 stewardship
Subsequent (visual-validation sprint): update agentic-developer/SKILL.md integration-mode section with tier-1->2->3 dispatch tree
Subsequent: add visual_triage logic to orchestrator screenshot-finding handling — every visual-regression + caller-flagged pendingPassing goes through tier-1 first

Validation: cost-per-screenshot drops >=3x vs all-Sonnet on 50-screenshot sweep; tier-1 outputs stable across N runs; blank/partial/feature_visible three-way empirically discriminating on real screenshots
